title: Snack Baskets Aftercare (ORIGINAL)
description: Lay back and relax for a little bit... sometimes that's what you need after a really intense session. You know what makes everything better when completely spent, with nothing left in the tank? Snack baskets! It's this fun little hobby of mine that I developed from my time working at the local foster centre. Adding and sourcing all sorts of snacks of various varieties. Everyone needs a break from time to time, to refuel and reenergize. I love the people watching too, so it is a great excuse to check which snacks they gravitate towards so I'll know what to stock up for them next time.
author: Mistress Shibby
